basic_profile.bio: A 31-year-old music enthusiast from Austin, Texas, who recently discovered the world of Reddit. By day, I work as a software developer for a local tech startup, but my true passion lies in exploring the emotional depths of music. I enjoy sharing and discovering hauntingly beautiful songs with others. When I'm not immersed in music, I love delving into genealogy and learning quirky facts about the world. Typically online during late evenings after work, I am single and enjoy the freedom to explore various hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is largely self-taught, accumulated over years of being an avid music listener and tech enthusiast. I hold a degree in Computer Science and have worked in the tech industry for several years, which has honed my analytical skills. My interest in genealogy and trivia stems from countless hours spent researching and learning from documentaries and online resources.
